description: This file declares the interface for the Fan Control Cluster in a Zigbee device, including callback definitions, creation, configuration, and access functions related to fan mode control.

methods.name: fanControlClusterCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Fan Control Cluster with specified callbacks and context.

methods.name: fanControlClusterSetBindingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables binding for the Fan Control Cluster based on configuration.

methods.name: fanControlClusterGetFanMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current fan mode for a specified device and endpoint.

methods.name: fanControlClusterSetFanMode
methods.description: Sets the fan mode for a specified device and endpoint.

methods.name: fanControlClusterGetFanModeString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string for a given fan mode value.
